caption: The drawing depicts a tall, hexagonal or octagonal decorative object, featuring panels with ornate detailing. It appears to be a container, possibly a vase or lantern, drawn in black and white. The central front panel showcases a vertical floral motif with leaves and blossoms, while the adjacent side panels contain geometric and possibly floral designs within bordered sections. At the top of the object, there is a rim bordered by a row of evenly spaced, rounded protrusions. The base is wider, solid, and rests on an ornately shaped, clustered support structure suggesting layered ornate work. The entire drawing is composed in shades of gray, black, and white, illustrating the object's edges, decorative features, and shading for a three-dimensional effect, set on an unadorned, light background.
title: Hall Candle Lantern
